writeup: Woot has a new Crimson AV JR3 universal projector mount for $79.51. The JR3 is a standalone ceiling mount that supports projectors up to 70 lb with tool-free adjustments (UPC 815885014116). Gungho Golf lists the matching JR3 with an add-to-cart option at $179, and FireFold lists the same black JR3 with matching UPC and an add-to-cart option at $207.59. That is 55 percent below the lowest verified store price and saves about $99. Woot showed 7 left with a limit of ten per customer.
